id: RIGID: IMU-resolved estimate with the full model vs with the upper body treated as rigid (upper-body joint velocities and accelerations set to zero in the inverse dynamics); offline replay of the ESTCMP2 logs (own arm motion without push, pushes without arm motion, quiet stance; seeds 1111-1113)

variants.FULL: IMU-SME as in the paper (all joint states)
variants.RIGID: same, upper-body (17) joint velocities and differenced accelerations replaced by zero; base acceleration still resolved from the IMU with the leg joint accelerations

metrics: arm runs (jab, swing, lift, gesture, 12 runs): peak two-tick |d_fast| after 2 s and runs above the 25 N entry threshold; push runs (px, py, 6): RMS horizontal error in double support 3.0-3.5 s; quiet (3): RMS noise

predictions.G1 upper-body state matters: arm runs: median peak |d_fast| RIGID >= 2 x FULL and runs above threshold RIGID > FULL
predictions.G2 no cost without arm motion: push and quiet runs: |RMS RIGID - RMS FULL| <= 2 N
